text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult man with long warm chestnut hair half tied into a high knot with an ornate clasp, amber gold eyes, pale warm skin, refined softly angular face, straight brows and restrained rose lips. Copper and gold embroidered fantasy robes over a dark high collar with a silver clasp, subtle fur-edged detailing. Calm warm expression. Continue the copper-gold fantasy robes into an ankle-length brocade overcoat over a continuous dark robe panel, wide embroidered waist belt and dark brown boots. Tall 192 cm lean athletic masculine build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
